svg.text: bound: 150,000 tokens
Synthetic: a generated session replayed through the real Contexto proxy against a local fake upstream. No model was
called.
Request sizes are estimates, not token counts: 1.8 bytes per token for pasted log text and 3.0 for everything else, with
no tokenizer.
The full-context and plain Claude Code lines are modelled from the script, not run: one request per turn on the script's
own estimate (log text at 1.8 bytes per token plus 20 tokens per reply, probe turns at 3.5 bytes per token).
The plain line compacts when a request would pass 150,000 tokens and continues from the head, a summary of 7,920 tokens
(docs/research/M0-proxy-measurements.md, finding 6: the mean output of three measured compaction summary calls (5,510,
8,908 and 9,342 tokens)) and the turn being served; that nothing else survives is an assumption, and it errs toward plain
Claude Code: anything re-attached would make its requests larger and its compactions more frequent.
Search reach is a floor under mechanical queries, not what a model can reach: one fixed query per fact, and beside it the
best query made from the question's own words. The best-query figure counts a page for a query only when every word of the
query is on the page as a whole word, not only inside a longer one, as the store's search may match it. Reach is measured
with the store's strict search (SessionStore.search), which counts a page only when it holds every word of the query, not
with the reply of the contexto_search tool: since D65 that tool falls back to approximate matches when no page holds every
word, and those are not counted. On the pinned session the tool's fallback answers 1 of the 18 queries the strict search
finds nothing for: for q_r_02 (paraphrase) its reply shows the plant's line on the second of the three pages it shows in
detail, beside two of the service's decoy lines. Which query a model makes is for the live run.
Every request of a turn, the rounds of a tool loop included, is plotted at that turn's history length, so a turn with a
tool loop (the file reads of the toolloop turn, the searches of a probe turn) shows as a vertical run of points.
A replay cannot show answer accuracy, cache reads, real token counts, what a real CLI does, what a real model does, what
the proxy does with what only Claude Code sends (its session start, its version, the role system messages of 5.x model
ids, thinking blocks, side requests).
